name: Flutter Skills
description:
7 skills that teach Claude Code how to build Flutter apps and games using modern best practices.

App Development:
• flutter-dev — Auto-activates when writing Dart/Flutter code. Covers Riverpod 3.0 with code generation, Freezed models, go_router, and feature-first architecture.
• flutter-feature — Scaffold a complete feature module (model, state, provider, repository, GraphQL, screen, test).
• flutter-model — Generate Freezed data models with JSON serialization and state classes.
• flutter-provider — Generate Riverpod 3.0 providers with notifier lifecycle and error handling.
• flutter-screen — Generate screens with go_router routing, Skeletonizer loading, pull-to-refresh.
• flutter-test — Generate tests with mockito mocks, ProviderContainer overrides, and test helpers.

Game Development:
• flutter-game — Complete guide for Flame 1.36 (Component System, physics, tilemaps, particles), flame_riverpod bridge, Rive animations, flutter_soloud audio, Nakama multiplayer,
AdMob/IAP monetization, and Impeller performance optimization.

All package versions verified against pub.dev. Patterns extracted from production Flutter apps.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills**.

- **Skills** (7): `flutter-dev` (Flutter development best practices with Riverpod 3.0, Freezed, go_router, and feature-first architecture), `flutter-feature` (Scaffold a complete new feature with models, providers, repositories, screens, widgets, and tests following feature-first architecture), `flutter-game` (Create 2D/3D games with Flutter using Flame Engine, Rive animations, and modern game architecture), `flutter-model` (Generate a Freezed data model with JSON serialization, optional state class, and factory), `flutter-provider` (Generate a Riverpod 3.0 provider with notifier, state management, and AwBaseNotifier lifecycle), `flutter-screen` (Generate a Flutter screen with go_router routing, Riverpod state management, and proper lifecycle), `flutter-test` (Generate comprehensive tests for Flutter providers, repositories, and widgets with mockito mocks and Riverpod overrides)

Installs with `claude plugin install flutter-skills@claude-community` from `dagovalsusa/claude-flutter-skills`.
